name: Chitose
source:
Known as the Demon Chieftain of the Nine Provinces of the Western Seas, he is also a member of the Ten-Demon Alliance. He has short light brown hair, red-colored eyes, and pale skin.

Chitose is the most cheerful out of all of the characters. His easygoing nature makes him very popular with other demons. He is somewhat over-confident, often letting a little praise go to his head. What makes him attractive to you is that he has a very expressive face and you are never bored in his presence. 

[Taken from [url=https://shall-we-date.fandom.com/wiki/Chitose]Demon's bond wiki[/url]]
